author: Vox
description:
Before she was incarcerated, former Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes approached A24 about creating a documentary about her life. Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim were given access to her life ahead of her jail time and created a film that had a shocking $15 million debut weekend at the box office last weekend. But despite its monetary success, did You Can See Everything give Holmes what she wanted? And exactly what is that, anyway?

author: Vox
description:
Democrats would only need four seats to take back control of the Senate. One of those seats could come from the state of Maine, where long-time Republican Sen. Susan Collins is fighting to hang on against Democrat Troy Jackson. But voters' frustration with President Trump could end her almost 30-year political career.

author: Vox
description:
Most career advice comes from an economy that no longer exists. So how do you make smart decisions about work when the rules keep changing? That’s where economic commentator and New York Times best-selling author Kyla Scanlon comes in. Each week on Best of Luck, she talks with economists, journalists, farmers, comedians and more to help us all make sense of the economy, and figure out how to make work work.

New episodes every Tuesday, starting October 27, 2026.
